target_customer: Banks and NBFCs, real estate developers, retailers, law firms and consumers in India who need property records, title checks and registry services
problem: Indian land and property records are fragmented across state registries and mostly offline, so buyers, lenders and lawyers struggle to verify ownership and encumbrances.
business_model: Pay per document and report for consumers, plus enterprise API and services revenue from lenders and developers
product_category: Proptech, property records and title search infrastructure

founders.name: Sanjay Mandava
founders.background_notes: YC profile says he was a proprietary trader and investment analyst at Knight Vinke and a real estate developer. Education not stated on the sources opened.

founders.name: Jonathan Richards
founders.background_notes: Listed as J Richards on the YC page with no background; named as co-founder by Inc42 in August 2022.

competitors.name: TEAL (Terra Economics & Analytics Lab)
competitors.what: AI and ML startup working on land and property records in India
competitors.funding_then: $2M pre-Series A led by Omidyar Network India with Info Edge

competitors.name: NoBroker
competitors.what: Property portal for rentals, buying and documentation; broader, described by Inc42 as not a direct competitor

technical_complexity.rationale: Records sit in many state systems with different formats and languages and need scraping, field officers and later AI document processing; hard operationally more than in research terms.

defensibility.rationale: Reconciled multi-state record coverage and registry field operations take time to replicate, though raw records are public.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No sources show a portal copying or buying the product by 2025; Landeed still raised independently in January 2025.

market_need_then: Inc42 and the YC page frame land disputes and opaque ownership records as a major pain; the YourStory 2022 coverage cites hundreds of thousands of app installs, and lenders needed collateral verification.

branding.domain_note: Uses landeed.com, apparently exact match; no acquisition story found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission-led and technical: 'making property computable', 'the blue tick for property'

branding.community_and_virality: Terra launch post claims 50,000 users in the first month without paid acquisition; no merch or fan communities found.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is a land plus deed pun but sources show little press about the brand itself; growth is attributed to product and enterprise sales.

outcome_analysis: Landeed is active and kept raising: a $2.5M pre-seed in August 2022, an $8.3M seed in January 2023 and a roughly $5M round in January 2025 labeled Series X by YourStory. It has moved from a consumer records app to enterprise APIs and AI title reports used by banks and developers, helped by repeat founders from GoLorry and a messy, high-need records market.
notes: A Paradigm Shift VC strategic round with undisclosed amount was reported by Inc42 and is not recorded as a round. The 2025 round was called Series X by YourStory and Seed VC III by an aggregator; stage set to other. Signalbase says Y Combinator led it, conflicting with 10x Founders Fund in other outlets. Seed figure also confirmed by Business Standard and Entrackr.
